title: console identity import wizard: no `manager_id` column to map, although import-users accepts a manager
body:
repo:objectstack#2 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmQ2SN4K183oqAvUajA

Filing gate ①: class a, from the final report 6933432108 of card #33113 (PR #34531), passed on by area `o2-D`. Dedupe: `identityImportFields manager`.

## 维护者速读

- 现象：控制台用户列表的导入向导里，可以映射的列有 email、phone_number、name、role、positions,没有 manager_id。接口本身接受 manager 列，但在界面上映射不了。
- 需要你做的：无。

## Evidence (re-check command)

`grep -n "name:" ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/IdentityImportPanels.tsx` near `identityImportFields`, compared with the columns `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/admin-import-users.ts` reads.

## Change

Derive the wizard's mappable columns from what import-users accepts, or add `manager_id` with the same label and validation rules as the other columns. Prefer one list both sides read over a second hand-kept copy. Pin it with a test that the wizard offers every column the endpoint accepts.

## Done when

The wizard maps a manager column end to end, and the pin test fails if the two lists drift.
